mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the sensory and motor fibres was most worthwhile: the picture made clear that incoming and outgoing signals travel along separate fibres within one nerve.

leastWorthwhile.text: Protecting the brain and spinal cord was clear but predictable; both pairings were shown directly in the pictures.

surprise.text: The spinal cord can produce rapid responses through local circuits without waiting for a conscious decision. I would have liked to see an example of one.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt purposeless, though joining the sensory and motor fibres was guided mainly by the named goal rather than a detailed explanation of how the nerve is assembled.

continue.text: I would choose to continue, especially to see an example of how a signal produces a response. The assembled model gives me a useful starting point.
